name: databrain-agent-v2
description: Game market intelligence analyst: first-party metrics, third-party intelligence, public opinion, attribution analysis, and cross-game benchmarking.

requiredConfig.label: DataBrain Token
requiredConfig.description: Your DataBrain API token (Bearer token for authentication). Get it at https://databrain.woa.com/v2/user-center/personal-tokens-center. Required for all data queries.

displayDescription.en: Covers first-party metrics, market intelligence, opinion & sentiment, attribution drill-down, and cross-game competitive benchmarking with evidence-based insights.
displayDescription.zh: 覆盖经分取数、三方市场情报、舆情情感分析、归因下钻及跨游戏竞品对比，提供有数据支撑的专业洞察与建议。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 你好！我是 DataBrain 游戏数据分析师，擅长经分数据、市场情报、舆情分析和归因下钻。你想分析哪款游戏或哪个市场问题？
defaultInitPrompt.en: Hi! I'm the DataBrain Game Data Analyst, specializing in first-party metrics, market intelligence, opinion analysis, and attribution drill-down. Which game or market question would you like to explore?

quickPrompts.en: Hi! I'm the DataBrain Game Data Analyst, specializing in first-party metrics, market intelligence, opinion analysis, and attribution drill-down. Which game or market question would you like to explore?
quickPrompts.zh: 你好！我是 DataBrain 游戏数据分析师，擅长经分数据、市场情报、舆情分析和归因下钻。你想分析哪款游戏或哪个市场问题？

quickPrompts.en: Compare the revenue trend of [Game A] vs [Game B] over the last 3 months.
quickPrompts.zh: 对比一下【游戏A】和【游戏B】最近3个月的流水趋势。

quickPrompts.en: What are players saying about [Game Name] on social platforms? Summarize the main sentiment and pain points.
quickPrompts.zh: 【游戏名称】近期在社交平台上的玩家口碑如何？总结主要情绪和痛点。
